title: Luxembourg & Belgium
route: Strasbourg → Bourscheid Castle viewpoint → Liège-Guillemins → Emmen
introTitle: A castle viewpoint and a Belgian railway landmark.
intro: Leave Strasbourg at 7:30 AM for a brief photo stop overlooking Bourscheid Castle and the Sûre Valley in Luxembourg. Continue to Liège-Guillemins railway station in Belgium for photos and lunch, then drive to Emmen in the Netherlands. No Belgium branch visit is planned. Driving estimate: 7 hours 19 minutes, excluding stops and traffic.

stops.name: Bourscheid Castle viewpoint
stops.description: Exterior viewpoint photos of the castle and Sûre Valley; allow 10–15 minutes. No castle tour.

stops.name: Liège-Guillemins railway station (P9 parking)
stops.description: Park at P9 on Rue de Sclessin, photograph the station, and have lunch nearby; allow about 60 minutes.

stops.name: Emmen
stops.description: Arrive in Emmen, aiming for 5–6 PM with traffic buffer.
